title: Lens Map
tagline: Collecting NFTs that are around the world by using Lens protocol.
description: Our application, called 'Lens Map,' tracks travelers' locations and allows them to share their trip stories through a map-based interface. Users can write posts about their trips on the map, and others can follow them to see their travels. Additionally, travelers can earn money through the platform. Lens Map is a practical application for businesses and organizations as well. By creating NFT badges of shops or any organizations on the map, customers and companies can interact in different way.
how_its_made: "The most interesting part is that we use the Lens protocol for our social travel platform. Among all the apps based on Lens, none have ever tried to put a map function on their app. With our app, users can post articles based on their location on the map. Additionally, we use non-fungible token technology to give shop owners the opportunity to create unique badges
